Implement a new function `decodeInlineNotes(input: string): InlinePart[]`. Export `InlinePart` as a discriminated union with `{ type: "text"; text: string }`, `{ type: "note" | "warning" | "key"; text: string }`, and `{ type: "route"; text: string; target: string }`. Recognize complete markers `{{note:payload}}`, `{{warning:payload}}`, `{{key:payload}}`, and `{{route:label|target}}`. A backslash escapes the next character both inside and outside markers and is removed from output; a trailing backslash represents a literal backslash. For routes, the first unescaped `|` separates label and target. Empty payloads and empty route fields are valid. Unknown, incomplete, or malformed markers are emitted as ordinary text. Markers do not nest. Return parts in source order, coalescing adjacent ordinary text into one part. Empty input returns an empty array and the function must not retain mutable state between calls.
